interface_mismatches: A2A owns packet processing and delivery leases while Mission Control is projection-only; the projection must not fabricate or mutate the native attempt lifecycle.
TaskStatus has no verifying member, so verifying and externally_promoted remain derived evidence phases rather than new TaskBoard lifecycle states.

Foundry evaluation, independent Vibe observation, signed candidate evidence, RuntimeState attestation, repository-effect authority, terminal receipt, and TaskBoard projection are distinct authority layers; no earlier layer may be silently promoted into a later one.

Cryptographic role separation is weaker than hostile-process independence: agent/run labels and public keys become authoritative only under composition-owned trust roots, durable identity admission, supervised process provenance, and exclusive private-key custody.
RuntimeReceipt records evidence but does not carry nominal effect authority; an effect evaluator must require a separate sealed capability and exact candidate binding.

Mission Control terminal reconciliation currently requires canonical mission_attempt_terminal evidence joined to its owner run and claim; direct A2A completion would create conflicting terminal evidence.
The isolated SQLite evidence snapshot is transient but the repository store inventory is lexical, so its filename must avoid a durable-store suffix while retaining SQLite WAL semantics.
